ops.new: and measures reported using Electronic Clinical Data Systems (ECDS).
ops.sources: NCQA HEDIS page (ncqa.org/hedis): "more than 90 measures across 6 domains of care: Effectiveness of Care, Access/Availability of Care, Experience of Care, Utilization and Risk Adjusted Utilization, Health Plan Descriptive Information, Measures Reported Using Electronic Clinical Data Systems"
ops.note: 90 measures / 6 domains verified; sixth domain was misnamed.

ops.old: MIPS, Star Ratings, and HEDIS all require at least one outcome measure in their quality reporting frameworks.
ops.new: MIPS requires clinicians to report at least one outcome measure (or another high-priority measure if no outcome measure applies), and the Medicare Advantage Star Ratings weight outcome measures three times as heavily as process measures.
ops.claim: MIPS, Star Ratings and HEDIS "all require at least one outcome measure"
ops.sources: CMS QPP Quality performance category requirements (6 measures incl. one outcome or high-priority measure); CMS Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (outcome/intermediate outcome weight 3, process weight 1)
ops.note: HEDIS is a measure set, not a reporting framework with such a rule; Star Ratings weights rather than requires.
